Background in Management, Computers & Engineering encompasses exceptional work ethic & commitment to achieve organizational objectives. A proactive manager, a team builder, a tactical planner and fast a learner with ability to attract key players in building strong and lasting business relationships. Flexible & versatile, can transcend cultural differences. Poised, competent and energetic under pressure, while maintaining humour.

privacy.text:
This policy explains what personal data {name} collects through this website, why, and the choices you have.

## Who we are

{name}
{address}
Phone: {phone}
Email: {email}
GSTIN: {gstin}
CIN: {cin}

## What we collect

- **Technical data:** basic information your browser sends to any website, such as its type and the pages requested. Optional cookies and similar tools are used only after you allow them in the consent banner.

## Why we use it

- to answer your enquiry or booking request
- to keep the website secure and stop misuse
- to meet our legal and tax duties

We use your details only for these purposes. We do not sell personal data.

## Who we share it with

Only with those who help us run this service:
- the companies that host this website and its database
- authorities, when the law requires it

## How long we keep it

Enquiries are kept for as long as needed to answer them. After that they are deleted.

## Your rights

You can ask us for a copy of your personal data, ask us to correct or delete it, withdraw a consent you gave, and name another person to act for you. In India these rights come from the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. To use them, or to raise a grievance, write to us using the details above. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you may approach the Data Protection Board of India.

## Children

This website is not meant for children, and we do not knowingly collect their data without a parent's or guardian's consent.

## Changes

We may update this policy. The date below shows when it was last changed.

Last updated: {date}

Please use the site lawfully and do not try to disrupt it, copy it in bulk or get into parts that are not public. We may change or withdraw content at any time.

## Information on the site

We take care to keep descriptions, prices, opening hours and availability correct, but mistakes can happen. If something is wrong we will correct it and tell you before going ahead with anything that depends on it.

## Intellectual property

The text, pictures, logos and design on this site belong to {name} or are used with permission. Please ask before reusing them.

## Liability

We are responsible for what the law says we cannot exclude. Beyond that, we are not liable for indirect loss or for problems caused by events outside our reasonable control.

## Privacy

How we handle personal data is explained in our Privacy policy.

## Law and disputes

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Please contact us first so we can try to resolve any complaint; otherwise the courts where we are based will have jurisdiction.

## Contact

{address}
Phone: {phone}
Email: {email}

Last updated: {date}
